title: T1-T12 NZ with stepwise rib cage reduction: W/o RH (Liebsch 2017)
subcategory: long segment with rib cage, stepwise reduction

quantity.name: NZ
quantity.definition: neutral zone: full-range rotation at 0 Nm of the last-cycle hysteresis (intersection with displacement axis)

source.authors: Liebsch C, Graf N, Appelt K, Wilke HJ
source.sample: 6 fresh-frozen human C7-L1 thoracic spines with entire rib cage (sternum, costal cartilage, ribs, intercostal muscles)

protocol.summary: C7 and L1 half-embedded in PMMA (screws in endplates; C7-T1 disc fixed with screws); L1 in angle flange at 20 deg (4 specimens) or 30 deg (2 hyperkyphotic). Pure moments +/-2 Nm at C7, FE/LB/AR, 1 deg/s (AR 0.5 deg/s), 3.5 cycles, last cycle; no preload. ROM of T1-T12 from optical markers on each vertebra.
how_to_simulate: Fix L1 (caudal) and leave C7-T1 rigid; apply pure moment +/-2 Nm to C7 in FE, LB, AR without preload
Model the rib cage structures present at this step (see ribcage.intact_structures)
Report rotation of T1 relative to T12 at peak moment; ROM = full range (e.g. flexion+extension); NZ = rotation at 0 Nm crossing of last-cycle hysteresis (full range)
protocol.notes: Mean +/- SD (data normally distributed). PC = % vs previous step, IC = % vs intact as printed in Table 1 (W/o IM: PC is also vs intact). Same 6 specimens later sternotomy-tested in Liebsch 2017 ESJ? see shared_sample_with.

data.note: Table 1 prints IC = -6.3 % (identical to PC; apparent typo, not recorded as pct_of_intact)

extraction.check_notes: Re-checked vs PDF text layer and rendered page 6/7; FE IC% for W/o RH 6-8 and W/o RH printed equal to PC (typo) -> null.

ribcage.intact_structures: all rib heads removed: ligamentous spine C7-L1 only

loading.rate: 1.0 deg/s FE and LB, 0.5 deg/s AR
loading.cycles: 3.5 cycles per plane, last (3rd) cycle evaluated
loading.branch: maximum deflection at +/-2 Nm of last cycle
loading.device: custom spine tester, Vicon MX13 6 cameras (0.1 mm / 0.1 deg)
